iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DATAGRAM
       Namespace DATAGRAM

DESCRIPTION
       iRules commands and events relating to TCP/IP/UDP/DNS header and payload information.

       Associated Events
	   FLOW_INIT
	   CLIENT_DATA
	   Note: DATAGRAM commands currently only work with CLIENT_DATA event invoked in context of a virtual server
		 with bigproto (or fastL4) profile.

HINTS
SEE ALSO
BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
